rules.note: Trait bonuses add to rolls only (the one exception is the Oil traits' Paper, which also takes the derived numbers its card lists); they never unlock perks, skill unlocks or classes.
rules.budget_note: Design budget: upside minus downside is about +3 SP; +1 on a roll costs 2 SP. Per-trait prices are not recorded in the source docs, so cost is null.
rules.music_shared: The three music traits share these rules. You start with a Musek Blestor, and you pick a real song as your character's Favourite Song. Starting the song costs 2 AP; it also starts on its own when you kill, revive an ally, or land a big heal or shield. While it plays, it replaces the area music or the fight music. The bonus lasts until 2 area changes have passed without the song, and the penalty starts after 4.
